coverage_limits: Maintainer attestation boundary: Validation verifies recorded evidence against git tree, commit, and file hashes rather than providing cryptographic reviewer authentication or hosted AI verification. It cannot prevent malicious edits to PR-controlled check scripts without independent maintainer review or branch protection.

File deletion behavior: validate-local-ai-review.py performs individual blob hash checks using git show HEAD:{name}. Deletions are securely bound by the reviewed_tree hash, but individual blob checks require all reviewed paths to exist in HEAD.
File mode verification: Mode changes (e.g., chmod +x) are bound cryptographically at the tree level via reviewed_tree rather than via the per-file sha256 content digests.
Baseline pinning: Baseline commit is strictly bound to the PR base (EXPECTED_REVIEW_BASE); any rebase or target branch update invalidates evidence and requires a fresh review.

Exclusion of evidence self-reference: The evidence path (.github/review-evidence/windows-fixes.json) is explicitly excluded from the pre-snapshot diff and is the only permitted file modification between reviewed_head and HEAD.

review_scope: Workflow, validator, policy and evidence design at snapshot; unchanged Windows source fixes covered by separate source_review below.

coverage_limits.description: Native Windows environments without Developer Mode or elevated privileges raise WinError 1314 (ERROR_PRIVILEGE_NOT_HELD) upon creating file or directory symlinks. Tests in test_preview_symlink_safety.py and test_windows_portability.py (such as test_render_html_rejects_symlinked_output_escaping_directory, test_render_html_still_follows_symlink_within_same_directory, test_render_html_accepts_symlink_into_a_subdirectory, test_render_live_html_rejects_symlinked_output_escaping_directory, test_open_safe_output_refuses_a_symlink_planted_after_the_check, and test_session_current_directory_symlink) skip gracefully via tests._symlinks.symlink_to. These skipped tests represent coverage gaps on unprivileged Windows systems.

Native Windows lacks POSIX directory file descriptor support (neither os.O_NOFOLLOW combined with os.O_DIRECTORY nor dir_fd in os.open are supported, setting _SUPPORTS_DIR_FD to False). Consequently, test_open_safe_output_leaf_creation_is_pinned_to_the_opened_directory cannot execute on native Windows and is skipped, leaving directory descriptor-pinned leaf creation untested on Win32.

trust_limit: Maintainer-recorded attestation; not independently authenticated AI output. PR-controlled validator cannot prevent malicious fabrication.
evidence_only_followup: Only this JSON is added after the reviewed snapshot; it was not represented as part of the old source-only review.

authoritative_windows_skip_counts.note: Original reviewer described 7/1; executed suite establishes 6/2. Raw result retained unchanged.
